tax.text: Ocasio-Cortez has proposed higher marginal tax rates on the very wealthy, saying the rich should pay more to fund programs like the Green New Deal.
tax.quote: People are going to have to start paying their fair share in taxes.

wages.text: She backs a federal jobs guarantee with a livable wage and has campaigned to raise the minimum wage.
wages.quote: Alexandria endorses a Federal Jobs Guarantee, because anyone who is willing and able to work shouldn't struggle to find employment.

housing.text: She supports large-scale construction of new public and affordable housing to make housing available to everyone.
housing.quote: We must take action to provide stable, affordable housing to everyone, once and for all.

safety.text: She favors investing in social supports rather than incarceration.
safety.quote: Instead of investing in mass incarceration, we need to invest in the most vulnerable members of our society.

immigration.text: She calls for legal status for undocumented immigrants and abolishing ICE.
immigration.quote: It is past time to make undocumented individuals full members of the country they call their home and abolish ICE.

guns.text: She supports universal background checks and an assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: Congresswoman Ocasio-Cortez is a strong supporter of gun reform legislation.

cannabis.text: She supports federally legalizing marijuana and decriminalizing drug use.
cannabis.quote: Marijuana should be legalized, and drug consumption should be decriminalized.

health.text: She is a lead supporter of Medicare for All to guarantee everyone health care.
health.quote: In a modern, moral society, no one should be too poor to get the care they need.

energy.text: As a Green New Deal author, she calls for a rapid transition to renewable and clean energy.
energy.quote: Now is the right time to create millions of jobs transitioning to renewable and clean energy.
